observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same scene: a red upholstered sofa set with ornate gold-colored wooden frames.
The set includes one 2-seater sofa and two 2-single armchairs.
The upholstery is red velvet or similar textured fabric with tufting and button tufting.
The gold frames have intricate carvings and decorative elements.
The floor is black marble-patterned tiles.
A fan is visible in the corner of the room in both photos.
The watermark 'LOVELY MICHAEL' is overlaid on both photos.
No brand or model markings are visible on the furniture in either photo.

claims.claim: A Royal unique 2 seater and complementary 2 singles sofas.
claims.evidence: No brand or model is visible in the photos. The term 'Royal' is not readable on the furniture. The set appears to be a 2-seater and 2 singles, which is consistent with the photos.

The upholstery appears clean and undamaged, but there are no close-ups of seams, buttons, or internal mechanisms to confirm condition. The term 'neatly used' is subjective and not verifiable from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
